## About
Gas Plumbing Technologies is a gas company based on NW 54th Street in Miami. We handle gas appliances, installations and service for both homes and businesses, working with natural gas and propane.
Along with the installation work, we sell gas appliances and propane tanks. If you're thinking about switching to gas or replacing an older appliance, ask us about our rebate program. Customers rate us 4.6 from 43 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tankless water heaters: A customer had us put in a tankless water heater at their home.
- Kitchens converted to gas: Want to cook with gas? A customer had their kitchen converted to gas, with the gas tank installed as well.
- Gas appliances and propane tanks: We sell gas appliances and propane tanks. Call for a quote and a sales representative will help you.
- Help with a gas violation issued by the city: If the city has issued a gas violation on your property, we can help take care of the problem.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on homes or businesses?
A: Both. We handle gas appliances, installations and services in residential and commercial environments, with natural gas and propane.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we'll put together an estimate for your job.

Q: Is there a rebate program?
A: Yes. Be sure to ask about our rebate program when you call for a quote.
